name: Nuki Smart Lock 4th Gen (EU)

radios.note: Nuki's generations table lists Thread but no built-in Wi-Fi for the standard 4th generation; only the Pro (4th generation) has Wi-Fi. The 2025 CSA entry text mentions Wi-Fi, but Nuki's own table is followed here.

matter.note: Several CSA entries exist for the standard 4th generation lock (product ID 0x00B0, Thread and Bluetooth); the Pro variants have their own product IDs.

apple_home.note: Nuki lists Apple Home for Matter over Thread. A Thread border router (HomePod mini, Apple TV 4K) is needed.

google_home.note: Nuki Web cloud integration; needs a Nuki Web account and remote access (Nuki Bridge or paid Thread remote access). Nuki says voice unlock is currently off in Google Home; app controls work. Matter via Thread also works with a Thread border router.

alexa.note: Nuki Web cloud integration (Nuki Smart Home skill), which needs remote access (Nuki Bridge or the paid Thread remote-access option) and a Nuki Web account. Matter via Thread is also supported; Nuki's hub table lists which Echo devices work for it.

smartthings.note: Nuki lists Samsung SmartThings as a Matter hub. A Thread border router is needed.

home_assistant.note: Home Assistant's Nuki page says 4th generation Smart Locks support Matter over Thread and integrate through the Matter integration. Needs a Thread border router. Home Assistant also documents MQTT for 4th generation locks.

hubRequired.note: Nuki says the Matter lock needs no bridge or module. Remote access needs either a Nuki Bridge (sold separately) or the paid Thread remote-access option. Matter control needs a Thread border router.

localControl.note: No Nuki source describes offline or local-only control explicitly.

lockFit.note: Mounts on the inside of the door over the existing cylinder. Nuki says the key still works from outside if the cylinder has an emergency function; otherwise use the Universal Cylinder, sold separately.

keypad.note: No keypad on the lock. Nuki sells the Keypad 2 NFC as a separate accessory.

power.note: Removable batteries: four AA cells or the rechargeable Nuki Power Pack (sold separately, up to 6 months per charge, per Nuki).

summary: Nuki Smart Lock 4th Gen mounts on the inside of the door over your existing cylinder and speaks Matter over Thread, with no bridge needed for Matter. Apple Home, SmartThings and Home Assistant connect through Matter; Google Home and Alexa also work through Nuki's cloud integration. It has no keypad of its own and runs on four AA cells or the rechargeable Nuki Power Pack.
caveats: Matter needs a Thread border router, such as a HomePod mini or Apple TV 4K; Nuki's hub table shows which Echo devices work.
Remote access needs a Nuki Bridge or the paid Thread remote-access option, and the Google and Alexa cloud routes need it plus a Nuki Web account.
Nuki says voice unlock is currently off in Google Home; app controls work.
Your key only works from outside if the cylinder has an emergency function; otherwise Nuki sells a Universal Cylinder.
The Keypad 2 NFC is a separate accessory.
